item.title: How to use Sentry with Vue
item.description: Integrating Sentry with Vue applications provides real-time error tracking, performance monitoring, and detailed stack traces for production debugging. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve integrated Sentry into numerous production Vue applications. Sentry captures errors automatically with context including user actions, browser info, and breadcrumbs leading to errors. This approach helps identify and fix production bugs quickly with comprehensive error data and alerting.

item.title: How to log errors in Vue
item.description: Logging errors in Vue applications helps track bugs, monitor application health, and debug issues in production. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve implemented comprehensive logging systems in enterprise applications. Vue’s global error handler combined with logging services captures errors with context for analysis and debugging. This approach provides visibility into application errors and helps maintain production stability.
